Late/Absence Procedures
You can report your child’s absence in either of the following ways:
You can report your child’s absence using the Studybugs app. This is completely free to use via your mobile devices and will help you to keep us up to date if your child is not well enough to attend school. It also gives you NHS advice on the illness you are reporting.
At Mansbridge Primary School, we are committed to meeting our obligations with regards to school attendance by:
We will also support parents to perform their legal duty to ensure their children of compulsory school age attend regularly, and will promote and support punctuality in attending lessons.
Good habits of attendance and punctuality are not only key factors in ensuring progress, both social and academic, but will also prepare pupils for life beyond compulsory schooling.
We need to work together, as a whole school community, to ensure that regular, punctual attendance is given a high priority by all staff, governors, parents, as well as the children themselves.
If you need support with your child's attendance, please contact the office to make an appointment with the Family Inclusion Support Officer, Mrs Moody.

2.
Extra challenge for this week if your child is confident with the activities:
Begin to learn from memory what makes 10. Can you remember which number pairs are added together to make ten? (1+9, 2+8 etc...) The song below is a fun way to help learn this.
What Makes Ten? - YouTube
If your child needs extra support in learning numbers to 10 please see the 'learning through play' activities for fun extra practise ideas. The games which show words for reading can also be adapted to number recognition.
The number song: https://youtu.be/qfcbWmASibk
Counting can be practised at lots of opportunities throughout the day for example, counting toys, counting steps and counting jumps.
Numberblocks: https://www.bbc.co.uk/iplayer/episodes/b08bzfnh/numberblocks?seriesId=b08bzg8q Choose any episode from series1 (all of these episodes are revision of what we have already learned).
https://www.bbc.co.uk/iplayer/episodes/b08bzfnh/numberblocks?seriesId=b0bl5v3r Choose from episodes: six, seven, eight, nine or ten.
